shares fell over 7% premarket on Monday after the company said its Board of Directors has elected not to declare a cash dividend for the third quarter and to suspend future dividends until further action of the Board.
The company said it continues to execute its performance improvement plan amid ongoing challenges in the macro-environment.

The company added that its Board is continuing to evaluate a broad range of strategic alternatives to maximize shareholder value and that the review is active and ongoing, and no decisions relating to any specific potential alternative have been made at this time.

title: Monro falls on announcing suspension of quarterly cash dividend
